text:
Aisha: hi all, pro tip gone wrong  tried using the kitchen island as a standing desk during standup, started a smoothie and immediately became a percussion section. mic picked up blender like a foghorn. any fast fixes? :face_with_hand_over_mouth: :blender:
DevBot: uploaded 1 file
Mateo: lol. easiest: hotkey mute or push-to-talk. software noise suppression (zoom background noise suppression set to high, or Krisp) works pretty well.
Aisha: I forgot push-to-talk exists. the meeting's live though.
Ruth: hardware trick: point your laptop mic away from the blender and cup your hand around it to form a mini baffle. ridiculous but works.
Qian: if you use PulseAudio on linux you can lower capture volume quickly: `pactl set-source-volume @DEFAULT_SOURCE@ 20%` or mute with `pactl set-source-mute @DEFAULT_SOURCE@ 1`.
Aisha: I'm on mac, any quick mac trick?
Theo: on mac `shift+cmd+A` cycles mute in zoom if it's in shortcuts, otherwise System Prefs > Sound > Input and drop input level. also AirPods or phone as mic via headphones helps if you have them.
Mateo: for long term, directional USB mics or lavalier clipped to shirt; while cooking, duck into another room or use phone as hotspot + phone camera/mic and go to the next room.
OpsBot: reminder: Kitchen is common space; please avoid noisy equipment during company-wide meetings between 10-11am. :bell:
Aisha: landed on the phone-in-next-room trick. posted a selfie of me awkwardly holding my phone and smoothie  :joy:
